## Tutorials

The YEAR() function returns the year part for a specified date.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT YEAR('2017/08/25') AS Year;

---

YEAR(
date
)

---

SELECT YEAR('1998/05/25 09:08') AS Year;
```

## Tutorials

The CAST() function converts a value (of any type) into a specified datatype.

Tip:Also look at theCONVERT()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT CAST(25.65 AS int);

---

CAST(
expression
AS
datatype(length)
)

---

SELECT CAST(25.65 AS varchar);

---

SELECT CAST('2017-08-25' AS datetime);
```

## Tutorials

The COALESCE() function returns the first non-null value in a list.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT 
  COALESCE(NULL, NULL, NULL, 'W3Schools.com', NULL, 'Example.com');

---

COALESCE(
val1
,
val2
,
....
,
val_n
)

---

SELECT 
  COALESCE(NULL, 1, 2, 'W3Schools.com');
```

## Tutorials

The CONVERT() function converts a value (of any type) into a specified datatype.

Tip:Also look at theCAST()function.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT CONVERT(int, 25.65);

---

CONVERT(
data_type(length)
,
expression
,
style
)

---

SELECT CONVERT(varchar, 25.65);

---

SELECT CONVERT(datetime, '2017-08-25');

---

SELECT CONVERT(varchar, 
  '2017-08-25', 101);
```

## Tutorials

The CURRENT_USER function returns the name of the current user in the SQL Server database.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT CURRENT_USER;

---

CURRENT_USER
```
